about: Sentences from two attempts to break src/server/rules.ts with several hundred inputs each, and from a review of it (15 November 2026). 'caught' must each lose the sentence that carries the address, email, number or account. 'kept' are ordinary sentences an earlier version damaged, and must come back exactly as written. 'dropped_on_purpose' look like real addresses, emails, numbers or accounts to a reader, so they are dropped even though a product might mean them innocently. 'known_through' still get past, and some of them a reader could follow: catching each would drop far more ordinary sentences than it is worth, and rules.ts says so where the choice is made. Characters that draw nothing are in here as themselves, so view this file with care.
